unknown_policy: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; missing data is never coerced to 0 and never counted as positive evidence

clamp.note: clamp applies only to KNOWN values inside the geometric mean; raw component values are stored unclamped

component_semantics.commercial_relevance: editorial size of the published instrument (nominal BRL). Not a lead score.
component_semantics.demand_fit: thematic fit to public-contract technical analysis (price index, amendment, term, documented adjustment). Not reachability.
component_semantics.insight_or_anomaly_strength: verifiable technical signal (event, material change, documented index, versioned peer gap). Atypical is not irregular.
component_semantics.documentary_richness: share of official fact fields that are KNOWN, plus sourced documents.
component_semantics.comparability: KNOWN only with a versioned peer sample; otherwise UNKNOWN. Missing peer is not a reject.
component_semantics.freshness: age of observation versus payload as_of (never wall-clock).
component_semantics.defensibility: sourced evidence on fired insight detectors.
component_semantics.citation_potential: official source + stable identity + dated evidence refs.
component_semantics.editorial_maintenance_cost: inverted maintenance burden (higher value = cheaper to keep current). Conflicts, missing docs and amendment volume raise cost.
component_semantics.reputational_sensitivity: inverted reputational exposure (higher value = safer). High sensitivity sets a review flag and never accuses.
